Overview.Name: Gubba Mounika
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + lemon water (no sugar)
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + soaked almonds (6 nos)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + fresh fruit (100 g)
Breakfast: Option 1: Vegetable upma (100 g) with mixed vegetables (50 g)
Option 2: Poha (100 g) with peanuts (15 g) and veggies (50 g)
Option 3: 2 small chapatis with vegetable curry (100 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Brown rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + mixed vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 2: Chapati (2 medium) + paneer curry (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 3: Millet khichdi (200 g) with vegetables (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Roasted makhana (30 g) + green tea (200 ml)
Dinner: Option 1: Light vegetable soup (250 ml) + 2 chapatis + veg curry (110g)
Option 2: Mixed vegetable stir-fry (150 g) + ragi roti (2 small)
Option 3: Paneer bhurji (100 g) with chapati (1)

Notes_and_Tips: If you lose control when eating, use small plates and pre-portion portions.
Avoid keeping high-sugar foods visible; replace with fruits and nuts.
Prefer whole grains and include protein-rich dals and paneer.
Keep a consistent eating window to reduce late-night energy intake.
Include gentle daily movement like walking or yoga to support mood.
When stressed, choose a short walk or deep-breathing instead of snacking.
